ImageDescription.value: Paseo is a photo-book based on a video of the same name shot by Richard Alpert while attending the premier of some of his video/film work at the Havana (Cuba) International Film Festival in 2018. The book was published on December, 2019 by On Deck Publishing. The artist’s website describes this collection as “…Walking through the streets of Havana Cuba I quickly got the impression that at least part of the Castro legacy was the creation of an urban landscape in severe disrepair. Everywhere there were derelict buildings, antiquated public facilities, and residential structures that must have been at one time exemplary of Hispanic architecture. Were these monuments of a failed social experiment or economic misfortune? What I hoped to capture with these photographs is a metaphor for the vibrancy and beauty of the Cubans against the crumbling cityscape using a kaleidoscope of patterns, colors, and textures.…

Categories.value: Files with no machine-readable author|Images uploaded by Fæ|Artworks without Wikidata item|Files from Wellcome Images|Japanese manuscripts, Wellcome Collection|Smallpox, textured illustration, Japanese manuscript, c. 1720

ImageDescription.value:
Japanese work on smallpox entitled Toshin seiyo [The essentials of smallpox] consisting of a manuscript in two volumes. It contains numerous coloured illustrations of different symptoms of smallpox, which were executed on separate sheets of paper: they were then cut out and pasted into place.

According to the beginning of book two, the author was Kanda Gensen (c1670-1746) and the text was edited and supplemented by one Enokimoto Gensho, whose dates are unknown and about whom all that is known is that he practiced medicine. Kanda was a doctor who is known for his illustrated explanatory works on natural science and materia medica.

Asian Collection
Keywords: Smallpox
